title: Mall-World Train Station Uncanny Workers
content: Have you ran into mallworld workers? Mall world is a place I have visited since I was a child and didn’t learn about the collective experience of mallworld until I was in my late 20s watching TikTok videos. I’ve been actively relearning how to lucid dream. It’s been a talent I can activate on accident but never had true control of the ability. I am working on active dream journaling and each time I go to sleep I go to sleep with the intention to wake up and explore mallworld. I woke up from my 4th journaled dream (this one during a 90 minute nap) and I woke up in mallworld in a NEW area I haven’t been to before. The dream was what I call mildly lucid. I wasn’t aware I was dreaming but I was aware something was “off”. The whole dream had an uncanny feel to it and I was in an endless train station that had the feel of an office building. When I was directed with this tablet that read F7 to go up an elevator I wound up in an empty area of a mall labeled F27. Realizing I was lost I was immediately redirected by another uncanny worker. She took my tablet and put it in the trash which I questioned but she ignored me and gave me an awkward unwanted hug and told me I needed to go to G7. My alarm woke me up but it was definitely mallworld and was the first time I’ve encountered “workers” at the mallworld. Has anyone else encountered these uncanny workers and what was your experience?
